title: 瑞银财富Eva Lee：AI竞争激烈，生态与分红成新焦点
speaker: Eva Lee

segments.en: So when you sort of analyze the situation, look at the competition's level, the how, whether one will be able to dominate the market share, and then you can pick your store, it's like, oh, I know that they have the ecosystem, the ecosystem will not disappear, the people already rely on the, you know, the chat, the payment, they already develop a habit, it's very tough for them to move, so I think these is also very important to understand now we're talking about AI monetization, who able to capture this, become a recurring earnings.
segments.zh: 分析时，要看竞争格局，谁能主导市场份额，然后选择标的。比如，有些公司拥有生态系统，用户已习惯其聊天、支付等功能，迁移成本很高。在AI商业化中，谁能抓住这些，形成经常性收益，这很重要。

segments.en: If investors can't be bothered with all that, if that's just a headache, picking the winners, are there other sectors that seem to be cleaner caught in, there's been a return to cyclicals and value recently, fixed income, I don't know, what are we missing as we obsess over this?
segments.zh: 如果投资者觉得选股太麻烦，是否有更清晰的板块？最近周期和价值板块有所回归，固定收益呢？我们是否忽略了什么？

segments.en: Recently we have been, we have talked about this yield, you know, seeking for yield, banks already have done very well, we start to see a bit of rotation as you showed earlier, a bit of rotation, domestic insurance companies, you know, should be also gaining this people seeking to invest, and not necessarily to equity market all the way, right, they might seek for some investment product over by insurance companies, domestic insurance companies, so that is going to do well.
segments.zh: 最近我们谈到追求收益，银行板块表现不错，我们看到一些轮动，国内保险公司也会受益于这种寻求收益的需求，人们不一定直接进入权益市场，可能会购买保险公司的产品，所以这类公司会表现良好。

segments.en: apart from that, some of the SOE actually started to do buyback and look at the share price, it really reflects that, so corporate governance, not just in China, I think also in Japan, a few Singapore, you know, we have some regions that these are even on a higher, I mean, US 10 years yields at 4.6, it's not low, but people still, you know, sort of think about what sort of a positive carry I can get from the different stocks, I think that's another element.
segments.zh: 此外，一些国企开始回购，股价也反映了这一点。公司治理改善不仅在中国，日本、新加坡等地区也有。美国10年期收益率4.6%不算低，但人们仍在考虑从不同股票中获取正回报，这是另一个因素。

segments.en: lastly, going overseas, we have been seeing certain sectors really already done a lot of work in the past in terms of breaking into the international
segments.zh: 最后，在出海方面，我们看到一些行业过去在打入国际市场方面已经做了很多工作。
